property_summary: After calling SetLogFile with a non-zero address, then calling Put and Collect with sufficient balance and time, in the reference contract the Log variable is set to that address (so it is non-zero), while in the mutant it remains zero address, causing a revert when trying to call a getter on it.
change_summary: Replace the require statement with a function that never modifies the log address, so SetLogFile never takes effect.
